sample_unit: simulated noise-level datasets from All of Us records

links.outcome: Model accuracy and variable impact scores under simulated random and non-random binary noise in inputs
links.effect: Increased noise consistently reduced classification accuracy across all models and noise types. Noise also diminished the variance of variable impact scores while leaving their means unchanged.
links.quote: Across all models and noise types, increased noise consistently reduced classification accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Accounting for EHR data inconsistency and noise when interpreting accuracy and hazard ratios

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the robustness/sensitivity of predictive models to data noise/inconsistencies using simulation on All of Us EHR data, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
